$comment: languages-world-2 (11 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for UZBEK, Latin (uz-UZ): allergiya (allergiyam bor), ko‘tara olmayman, intolerans, sezgir, seliakiya / tseliakiya, the -siz free-from forms (glyutensiz, sutsiz, tuxumsiz, yong‘oqsiz, laktozasiz, baliqsiz…), glyuten / sut / yong‘oq yo‘q, xavfsiz, uchun mos, yeya olmayman, menga mumkin emas, kontaminatsiya — stems survive the suffixes (yong‘oqsizmi). o‘ / g‘ are listed with every apostrophe customers type (' ‘ ʻ ʼ or none). Cyrillic Uzbek (глютенсиз, сутсиз, ёнғоқсиз, хавфсиз) and the Russian words customers mix in are added. Bare siz is NOT a stem (siz = you; piyozsiz is a preference), nor bare izlar (inside sizlar) or mumkin emas. OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
